bayts.text: The Real (Al-Ḥaqq) has brought me from the manifest Truth; He has led to me what is apparent and what is not apparent.
He taught me what was before creation, He Who has been for me with generosity and largesse.
There has not come toward my person what draws the fires, nor what draws the two shames and loss.
The harm of this world's fire has not reached me, and the Everlasting (Al-Bāqī) has singled me out with the best exception.
He made me master of what He never sold away from me, and led His permanence to me by grace.
My charism is the Book of Him Who by it raised me to the Gardens, ever since He benefited me.
He erased a death that was heading toward the souls, and drove it toward others than me, as relief.
Toward a direction other than mine is death's heading: it has headed toward all souls with passing away.
The harbingers of death have not come toward me, and I have raised my voice with permanence.
The death of those who tormented me is in exchange for the death of my soul: no dispute has come toward me.
My shield against death is the permanence of Allah: Allah has made me abide for the Face of Allah.
The Everlasting has spared me death for ever, and by my permanence He gladdens Aḥmad.
He has benefited me and not harmed me, nor does He harm me: all of me has relied on Him.
My shield against diseases and death is the permanence of Him Who guards me from (enemies') gloating.
He made known to me that He is leading the House (the Kaʿba) to me, raising through me what is pleasing.
There is no doubt that I shall be, with the Trustworthy (Muḥammad), within it, with the Book and with the Trustworthy (Gabriel).
The Trustworthy (Muḥammad) and the Trustworthy (Gabriel) have made me master of the Book of an Everlasting One: security has come to me.
The conclusion of my intimate converse in writing, by this script: Allah – blessed and exalted be He – has made me
His servant, His intimate friend and His beloved, outwardly and inwardly, and His neighbour,
and servant of the Messenger of Allah – may Allah the Most High bless him and grant him peace –.
And Allah is Guardian over what we say (Qurʾān 28:28). And Allah – blessed and exalted be He – has borne witness
for me the pact of the thirty-three and of the consciences, and has taken the Highest Assembly as witness
of this. But Allah bears witness to what He has sent down to you (Qurʾān 4:166); a greeting from
Allah, blessed and good (Qurʾān 24:61). Allah bears witness that there is no god but He,
and (so do) the angels and those endowed with knowledge, He Who upholds justice: there is no god but He,
the Mighty, the Wise. Truly the religion with Allah is Islam (Qurʾān 3:18-19). And Allah has borne witness
– blessed and exalted be He – that the writer of these letters shall never die,
and that the death which was heading toward him in His word – exalted be He –: "Every
soul shall taste death" (Qurʾān 3:185), He has erased its heading toward him, in the measure of the greatness of His Essence, without anything being turned
from it toward him, ever. And Allah is Guardian over what we say. Allah – blessed and exalted be He – has written
that the Sacred House of Allah (the Kaʿba) shall be raised by the angels to Ṭūbā (Touba), and in it (shall be) the Messenger of Allah – may there bless him
Allah the Most High and grant him peace – together with the Trustworthy of Allah's revelation (Gabriel); and there shall enter with the two of them
the writer of these letters with all the books and belongings, toward his place which
shall be with them in it, that is, (with) the sincere disciples. Allah – blessed and exalted be He – has written
that the writer of these letters, Allah – blessed and exalted be He – has made him safe from what does not lead to
the good, and that he perseveres in what is not hidden from Allah – blessed and exalted be He – before this night
in what is with Him, then. Allah – blessed and exalted be He – has written that the writer of these
letters shall be near Allah – blessed and exalted be He – in this world, in repelling and attracting, for four hundred
years after this writing, made certain by the manifest Truth. And Allah is Guardian over what we say.
